method.bootstrap: 2,000 draws, seed 20261015, fixture clusters keeping all topologies, 95% percentile. Describes fixed-corpus variation, not representative sampling; parameter seeds produce related instances and are not independent families.
method.primary_aggregate: equal-case-weight geometric mean of positive paired ratios on the stable paired cohort
method.scope: Pinned configured pipelines, unequal search effort and ideal synthetic connectivity. No claim of best settings, optimality, language causality or hardware fidelity. Report all results without tuning or replacement.
method.secondary_aggregate: family-balanced geometric mean; equal weight across six fixed generator families
method.zero_policy: Zero numerator/denominator excluded from logarithmic ratios and counted; all pairs retained in win/tie/loss counts; no pseudocount.

scope: Each case/tool/session needs all five timed trials and every initial/replacement warmup compiled and independently passed. A failure excludes the whole cell; never select successful trials. Main comparisons use pairwise cells eligible in both sessions; the four-tool common cohort is reported separately. Status/verification coverage for ALL selected cases, including unqualified cells, remains visible.
